# Documents whose rendering in Chrome changes once inlined, with the reason.
# Format: <fixture>  <reason>. Self-ratcheting like the parity lists.
#
# Each reason says whose behaviour it is: a juice bug this package copies for
# parity, a limit of inlining itself, or a gap here.

cascade/nonvisual  limit: the rule matches the <html> element a browser creates around a fragment, which has nothing to inline onto
cascade/selector-list-ties  limit: :only-child matches the <html> element a browser creates around a fragment, which has nothing to inline onto
duplicates/variables  juice bug: with inlineDuplicateProperties, var() reads the first rule's custom property rather than the one that wins the cascade
ignore/next-across-blocks  juice bug: an ignore comment carried into the next <style> block stops that rule being inlined, but that block does not keep it, so it is lost
ignore/next-rule  limit: a rule juice is told to ignore stays in <style>, where inlined declarations outrank it
ignore/pseudo-and-semicolon  juice bug: a stray semicolon before a rule makes browsers drop that rule as an invalid selector; juice applies it
ignore/start-end  limit: a rule juice is told to ignore stays in <style>, where inlined declarations outrank it
ignore/start-unterminated  juice bug: an ignore comment carried into the next <style> block stops that rule being inlined, but that block does not keep it, so it is lost
important/attr-pseudo  limit: inlinePseudoElements turns ::after into a real <span>, an element the original never had
juice-suite/inline-content/ignore-pseudos  juice bug: pseudo-class rules in extraCss are dropped rather than preserved, so a:link styles are lost
juice-suite/juice-content/nesting-atrule  limit: an inlined declaration outranks a later rule kept in a preserved @media block
juice-suite/juice-content/pseudo-elements  limit: inlinePseudoElements turns ::before/::after into real <span>s, elements the original never had
juice-suite/juice-content/pseudo-elements-and-width-attr  limit: inlinePseudoElements turns ::before/::after into real <span>s, elements the original never had
l4-spec/attr-unquoted  juice bug: [width=600] is not valid CSS (an unquoted value must be an identifier), so browsers drop the rule and juice applies it
l4-spec/dangling-combinator  juice bug: a combinator with nothing on one side is not valid CSS, so browsers drop the rule and juice applies it
l4-spec/is-in-not  limit: :not() matches the <html> element a browser creates around a fragment, which has nothing to inline onto
l4-spec/universal-type  juice bug: "*a" is not valid CSS, so browsers drop the rule and juice applies it to <a>
malformed/stray-closing-bracket  juice bug: browsers drop a declaration that starts with punctuation such as ")" and juice applies it
malformed/unclosed-double-quote  juice bug: browsers end a string that never closes only at a line break, so they drop the rules it runs over, and juice applies them
malformed/unclosed-quote  juice bug: browsers end a string that never closes only at a line break, so they drop the rules it runs over, and juice applies them
markup-decl/close-tags  parser: the browser parses the original by HTML5 rules, and the output follows htmlparser2's tree, as juice's does
nesting/dangling-combinator  juice bug: a nested selector ending in a combinator is not valid CSS, so browsers drop the rule and juice applies it
nesting/media  juice bug: @supports blocks are neither inlined nor preserved, so their rules are lost
nesting/stray-paren  juice bug: browsers drop a declaration that starts with punctuation such as ")" and juice applies it
nesting/top-level-amp  juice bug: a top-level & means :scope, the root element, which juice never matches
nesting/top-level-amp-document  juice bug: a top-level & means :scope, the root element, which juice never matches
premailer-suite/misc/style_with_data_in_content  juice bug: the content property is dropped from elements, but on <img> it replaces the image
premailer-suite/misc/style_without_data_in_content  juice bug: the content property is dropped from elements, but on <img> it replaces the image
premailer-suite/misc/unmergable_media_queries  limit: an inlined declaration outranks a later rule kept in a preserved @media block
premailer-suite/premailer/rgb_color_is_not_matched_without_three_color_arguments  juice bug: an invalid color is copied into bgcolor, where legacy attribute parsing turns it into a real color
pseudo-elements/content-markup  limit: inlinePseudoElements turns ::before/::after into real <span>s, elements the original never had
pseudo-elements/empty-argument  limit: inlinePseudoElements turns ::before/::after into real <span>s, elements the original never had
pseudo-elements/trailing-combinator  limit: inlinePseudoElements turns ::before/::after into real <span>s, elements the original never had
roundtrip/p-not-closed  parser: the browser parses the original by HTML5 rules, and the output follows htmlparser2's tree, as juice's does
variables/function-name  juice bug: var (--x), with a space, is resolved, but CSS treats it as invalid
